🇨🇳 中文说明"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"nd motivates me to keep developing it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ⚡ Overview"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**`dsh-model-sync`** keeps your **DeepSeek Harness** model catalog up-to-date with upstream AI provi"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"h-model-sync`** keeps your **DeepSeek Harness** model catalog up-to-date with upstream AI providers."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Instead of manually editing YAML configs whenever a provider launches a new model, adjusts context w"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"indow limits, or changes pricing, `dsh-model-sync` automatically discovers new releases, updates cap"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ability metadata (`vision`, `tools`, `reasoning`, `embeddings`), tracks account balances, manages mo"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"del selection visibility, and reconciles models on the fly without server restarts."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## ✨ Key Features"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"* 🏷️ **Smart Collections & Catalog Auto-Tagging**: Automatically categorizes models into standardize"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"d tags (`coding`, `reasoning`, `fast`, `vision`, `long-context`) during discovery, provides fast pil"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"l-button filtering in the Web UI, and introduces a one-click "⭐ Curated Best" selection preset for t"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"op flagship models.
* ⚡ **Latency TTFT Radar & Sparklines**: Probes response latency and Time To Fir"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"st Token (TTFT) across models, renders ASCII sparklines (` ▂▃▂ `) and 4-tier speed badges (⚡ `< 300m"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"s`, 🟢 `< 1.2s`, 🟡 `1.5 - 3.0s`, 🔴 `> 3.0s`), and exposes `GET /dsh-model-sync/health/latency` for in"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"telligent downstream routing.
* 💸 **Dynamic Live Pricing Sync & Prompt Caching**: Periodic backgroun"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"d updates of live model pricing from OpenRouter and LiteLLM snapshots with persistent disk fallback "},{"id":"p12s9","text":"cache, tracking prompt cache read/write costs (`cacheReadPerToken`, `cacheWritePerToken`), with `GET"},{"id":"p12s10","text":" /dsh-model-sync/pricing` and `POST /dsh-model-sync/pricing/sync` endpoints.
* 💰 **Built-in Referenc"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"e Pricing Database**: Canonical token pricing database automatically enriches models for OpenAI, Ant"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"hropic, Groq, Mistral, xAI, and DeepSeek, enabling cost-limit filtering and `@cheap` auto-resolution"},{"id":"p12s13","text":" even when upstream APIs omit pricing metadata.
* 🎯 **Dynamic Smart Virtual Aliases & Auto-Fallback*"},{"id":"p12s14","text":"*: Route requests to virtual aliases like `@fast`, `@cheap`, and `@best-code`, with automatic fallba"},{"id":"p12s15","text":"ck chains when circuit breakers open or health probes fail.
* 📏 **Real Context Limits & Boundary Saf"},{"id":"p12s16","text":"ety (`contextWindow` / `maxOutputTokens`)**: precise separation of input and generation limits, prev"},{"id":"p12s17","text":"ention of 400 `max_tokens` errors via auto-clamping, and clear `In: 128k | Out: 8k` badges in Web UI"},{"id":"p12s18","text":".
